findings.text: Cluster range release is globally visible and settles accounting and returns clusters to free or partial residency.
Swap slot invalidation hook is globally visible and drops any compressed backing association for the given entry.
Compressed store memory control uncharge is globally visible and adjusts container accounting with early exits for nonstandard hierarchy and root.
Compressed allocator object release is globally visible and recycles handles and reclaims empty backing pages as feasible.
Zone page state decrement is globally visible with build dependent forms that fold per cpu differences into zone totals.
Cluster range release serves as the entry for freeing a contiguous run of swap slots after their last reference has gone.
Object release serves as the entry for ending handle lifetime and triggering page reclamation checks.
Zone state decrement serves as the entry used by allocator teardown to update residency tallies.
Swap table encodings form exclusive categories for cleared, shadow tagged, frame backed and defective markers, with a countable subset covering cleared, shadow and frame forms.
Count and flag subfields are meaningful solely for countable encodings and their accessors assume that precondition.
Shadow construction preserves value tagging plus a distinguishing mark and encoded flags, with flags placed by shifting a narrow octet into position.
Frame decoding strips flag bits before translating the frame number to its folio descriptor and requires prior frame marking.
Cleared slot construction yields a cleared word compatible with atomic slot width and also clears inline flags on store.
Cluster occupancy is reduced by the released span length and residual occupancy selects terminal disposition.
Cluster position derives from pointer displacement within the device array and base offset scales that index by cluster span.
Empty verification expects cleared slots with cleared container association, tolerating defective markers solely during teardown in line with occupancy.
Range release preserves ordering so that cleanup effects are visible before global and device availability are restored.
Availability list membership is guarded by an off list marker combined with fullness checks under a global avail lock.
Compressed store lookup shards entries across many trees selected by swap type and shifted offset.
Compressed entry teardown leaves no residual linkage, pool, container or accounting references.
Container uncharge for compressed store is skipped outside the default hierarchy and for root, otherwise byte and entry tallies are reduced.
Fullness classification distinguishes vacant and saturated endpoints from intermediate utilization bands derived from inuse proportion.
Backing page identity is validated by a magic marker and a huge marker collapses chaining to a singleton.
Per cpu state deltas accumulate locally with threshold overflow folding the excess into zone totals with hysteresis.
First component detection relies on a private flag held by the underlying page.
Object release updates inuse tally and freelist linkage, with huge objects clearing their handle directly.
Blank page marking is cleared either inline within the slot or via a separate bitmap depending on build capability, under cluster lock.
Builds without container support provide inert accessors that always report empty identity and perform no clearing.
Nested decrement helpers forward page based requests to zone based per cpu handling.
Handle and page descriptor carriers are recycled through dedicated caches after teardown.
Lockless page teardown requires vacant inuse tally, vacant fullness marker and held component locks.
Page descriptor reset detaches owner and successor links and clears the private flag and retains the sticky allocator marker.
Zone residency decrement for allocator pages forwards to generic zone accounting for the allocator residency item.
Cluster table mutation and observation require the cluster lock held, with the table pointer resolved under read copy update discipline.
Container table lookup and clearing require the cluster lock held, with absent tables treated as empty identity.
Cluster list relocation nests the device lock inside the cluster lock and updates the flag after linkage has moved.
Cluster free, immediate free and partial paths all assert the cluster lock held.
Availability list changes serialize on a global avail lock with device state rechecked under hold.
Size class statistics and fullness lists are mutated under the class lock across classification changes.
Page set acquisition for reclamation attempts all component locks and unwinds those already taken on failure.
Cluster descriptor aggregates a lock, occupancy tally, flag, order hint, list linkage, table pointer and optional container, blank marking and extension storage.
Swap table indirection uses a protected pointer to an array of atomic slots indexed by intra cluster offset.
Size class aggregates a lock, per fullness chains and object statistics.
Backing page set aggregates inuse tally, fullness marker, list linkage, initial component pointer, huge marker and magic.
Page descriptor aliases folio and page storage with lock, reference, state and mapping operations forwarded to the underlying folio.
Cluster residency moves among unlinked, partially occupied, fully free and discard pending, with vacant occupancy selecting free or discard and residual occupancy selecting partial.
Slot encoding moves among frame backed, shadow, cleared and defective, with release converting countable shadow forms to cleared and defective persisting for diagnostics.
Fullness residency migrates backing sets between utilization lists on occupancy change, with vacancy triggering a reclamation attempt.
Compressed entry residency spans tree presence through erase to staged release of backing resources.
Table storage reclamation defers across a grace period for page backed storage and releases immediately for cache backed storage.
Discard capable devices divert vacant clusters to asynchronous work rather than immediate release, relying on flags to prevent duplicate queueing.
Unacquired component locks lead the allocator to kick background reclamation instead of blocking the releaser.
Invalid handles are silently ignored on release and empty compressed stores short circuit invalidation.
Threshold reads for zone accounting may race with migration yet self correct on the next update.
Container uncharge groups consecutive slots sharing the same identity and flushes the pending batch on identity change.
Cleared slot encoding is the all clear word pattern compatible with atomic slot width.
Countable encodings reserve dedicated subfields for count and flags at fixed mask and shift positions with flag width fitting within a single octet.
